title: arnica austriaca
intro: Arnica austriaca, commonly known as leopard's bane, is a perennial plant in the daisy family native to Europe. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and accelerating wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Arnica austriaca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties, which work to soothe and calm the skin and muscles. The bioactive constituents of Arnica austriaca include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
